title: Trailing zeros of 100!
question: How many trailing zeros are there in the decimal representation of $100!$? Write a single integer.

title: Heron area plus divisor sum
question: A triangle has side lengths 13, 14, and 15. Let A be its area. Let S be the sum of all positive divisors of A. Find S. (Show the Heron-formula algebra and the divisor enumeration entirely in your private reasoning; visible reply = one integer.)
